changes:
FEX from Aurora's fork (aurora-silicon/fex 4f0c04b785f) with alarm-aurora's three patches, its RootFS and graphics-provider integration and the "FEX (Aurora)" Steam compatibility tool (fex-emu-steam).
FEXConfig is split into fex-emu-config, so fex-emu does not pull in Qt.
The provider's bind at /run/fex-emu/rootfs is read-only, nosuid and nodev.
Started with credentials its caller did not have (AT_SECURE), FEX reads only the system's configuration, including /run/fex-emu/Config.json, and the system's directories.
binfmt_misc registers FEX without the credentials flag (C): an x86 program with the set-user-ID or set-group-ID bit runs with its caller's credentials.
notes: No Debian package provides the x86-64 RootFS image (alarm-aurora depends on fex-emu-rootfs-arch); see docs/parity/graphics.md. Cross builds skip fex-emu-config (Qt 6).
